### E5 (writes another product's published rules call owed at once)
- Mold: the haul-off line in SRC-2 is a line the published rule says every such job carries. A solver could not book it mid-call: the mold job is invoiced, and "every other scope line and every equipment day still requires the job to be in remediating, awaiting clearance or cleared status when it is charged" (`asbestos_presampling_charge_8b37f2c2`). Even if it were booked, it would only raise the mold balance (already above zero); the payment due date would not move, so the credit multiplier could not change. The 2026-09 late fee is already posted, and the published rule allows at most once per calendar-month fee period, so no further late fee is owed before 2026-10. The customer refuses to pay the mold balance on this call.
- No claim file, service agreement, fire, contents or rebuild record exists for this customer.
- The water scored reads (charges posted, payments posted, job fields) can be moved only by the two prerequisite writes themselves.
E5: PASS.
